description: chat Power BI brings generative AI from top providers — like OpenAI (ChatGPT) and Anthropic — directly into your Power BI reports. With it, developers can build embedded AI agents that allow users to interact with their data through natural language questions, such as: "What were the sales last quarter?" or "What strategies can I use to increase my revenue?" Benefits for users and developers - Intuitive interaction: Users can explore data using plain language — no need for DAX or advanced filtering skills. - Cleaner dashboards: Reduce the number of charts and tables and keep the focus on actionable insights. - Versatility: Suitable for multiple industries, including finance, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and more. - Data security: All data is processed locally within the report — only the query and context are sent to the AI model, ensuring data privacy. Premium features - Message logging: Track user conversations to identify common questions and evaluate response quality. - Advanced AI models: Access the latest and most powerful models from top providers (the free plan uses a simpler model). - Bring Your Own LLM (BYO LLM): Connect your own model deployment to keep all requests within your corporate network. - Usage limits: Set token limits per hour, day, or month per license key.
